Resolves #21187

Related: #21175 · #21142 · #21140
Companion cover PR: https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/142

Adds `examples/grid/cellTypes` (`Neo.examples.grid.cellTypes.*`), showcasing all fourteen non-`tree` built-in `Neo.grid.column.*` types (`index`, `githubUser`, `countryFlag`, `sparkline`, `animatedCurrency`, `component`, `progress`, `currency`, `icon`, `animatedChange`, `iconLink`, `linkedin`, `githubOrgs`, `column`) on one 32-row open-source maintainer sponsorship and activity directory, with a footer line disclosing which columns are public profile data and which figures are generated for the demo. Each column header names its config type (`# · index`, `Maintainer · githubUser`, …), `MainModel` derives `goalPercent` via a `calculate` field from `pledged` and `annualGoal`, `MainStore` generates initial sponsorship figures from Mulberry32 (`0x21187`) over verified public accounts indexed in DevIndex (`users.jsonl`), and `MainContainer` drives a seeded periodic live feed (`0x21187feed`) with `Pause feed` / `Resume feed`, `Reset`, `+$250` per-row sponsorship buttons, and `Dark theme` / `Light theme` View Transition switching. Registers `grid-cell-types` in `examples.json`, `example-captures.json`, `seo.json`, and `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (`125` records, `grid-table: [20, 0]`).

Evidence: L3 (unit, SEO, static guards, and Playwright E2E green locally; whole-surface Portal `Grid & Table` released/changed pair + `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` light/dark frames refreshed at head; two-pass byte-identical cover capture merged on `neomjs/pages` `main` in `neomjs/pages#142`; two swapped-order cold readers; design-seat read requested from `@neo-fable-clio` in `MESSAGE:32e3c75a-3f13-4b9a-af2e-8c3927004cc6`) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-8). Residual: post-deploy live `neomjs.com` card verification, Residual-Owner: #21175.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` and `Commit authorship` run in CI.

## Deltas from ticket
- Included all 14 non-`tree` built-in column types (exceeding the `>= 12` floor, adding `column` alongside the 13 specialized types) and sized columns so the `640 × 360` cover frames 4 types (`index`, `githubUser`, `countryFlag`, `sparkline`) flush at `640 px` and the `1440 × 900` desktop opening frame lands 9 types flush at `1440 px` without locked-region gutters on `390 × 844` phones.
- Configured `compareField: 'lastDelta'` on `AnimatedCurrency` (`src/grid/column/AnimatedCurrency.mjs:83` checks `< 0` on `compareField || dataField`, whereas cumulative `pledged` is always positive) so positive sponsorship ticks flash `.neo-animated-positive` and negative adjustments flash `.neo-animated-negative`.
- Noted out-of-scope engine finding (`defect-note` broadcast, promoted in #21526 / #21527): `GridContainer#applyResponsiveLockPolicy` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1177`) mutates multiple columns' `locked` synchronously in one loop, firing concurrent async `onColumnLockChange` rebuilds when a breakpoint unlocks `>= 2` columns at once.

- **Challenge**: (1) **Blocking (`RA-1`)**: the rows pair real people's photos, full names, cities and LinkedIn links with invented `Pledged`, `Goal`, `Funded %`, `Commits` and `Tier` values under a "sponsorship" frame, beside a `+$250` *Back* button. (4) **Blocking (`RA-2`)**: `onResetButtonClick` clears sorting with `grid.columns.items.forEach(column => { if (column.isSorted) column.isSorted = null })`. `grid.columns` holds the `Neo.grid.column.*` instances, and the sort indicator is the header button's state (`Neo.grid.header.Button#isSorted`, cleared by its `removeSortingCss()`, which `GridContainer#removeSortingCss` calls). The loop therefore cannot reach the arrow. Whether Reset still leaves a sorted-looking header depends on whether `resetDirectory()`'s `clear()` + `add()` fires the grid's `onStoreLoad` (which calls `removeSortingCss()` when no sorter is left). No spec covers sort → Reset, so I could not settle that from the diff.
